A '''shakudo pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper pickaxe]] with [[shakudo alloy]]. It has [[Silk Touch]] built in, one of the few ways to mine with Silk Touch in a pack without enchanting tables.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the copper item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed 9, the same as a [[diamond pickaxe]], and has 1000 durability. Its only restriction is obsidian itself, which breaks at speed 3 without dropping; crying obsidian and ender chests are harvested normally.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Its [[Silk Touch]] intrinsic makes blocks drop themselves. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage with no attack cooldown: the item sets a damage bonus but no attack speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[shakudo alloy]], which lets the alloy be reused on a fresh copper item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 1.2 (real value 4).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_pickaxe.json}}</ref>
* Shakudo tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive (2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper instead of 3 gold and 6 copper ingots). A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
